packs.name: Anusaaraka English-Hindi Dictionary (FreeDict)
packs.description: General-purpose English to Hindi dictionary of ~22,000 everyday headwords with a part of speech and an English example sentence for each. The main English-Hindi pack: unlike Wiktionary's translation tables it covers ordinary verbs.

packs.name: Wiktionary English to Hindi
packs.description: Hindi translations attached to English Wiktionary entries, with the English sense that each translation belongs to. The main English-Hindi pack.
